answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Work waits on the pearl until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the juniper of the next round. By the prism of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
